produces: Generate the headline corpus totals, refusal classes, first-blocker counts, per-figure outcomes, crashes, and coverage blind spots from one deterministic harness run so status.md can be refreshed without hand transcription.

conditions: One command emits every metric currently maintained in docs/status.md.
The in-scope denominator excludes custom-figure parses and deliberate deferrals exactly as user-ruled.
A checked fixture or snapshot detects changes to metric classification.
